# PrintMeArt

> PrintMeArt is a family-run print studio in 's-Hertogenbosch (Den Bosch), the Netherlands. We sell museum-quality prints of public-domain masterpieces — Van Gogh, Monet, Winslow Homer, Turner, Avercamp, the Dutch Golden Age and more — as giclée prints on fine-art cotton paper or as a Premium Poster photographic print, in many sizes and with an optional white passe-partout. Customers can also upload their own photo or artwork to have it printed.

The shop is available in Dutch (default) and English: every page exists under https://printmeart.nl/nl/ and https://printmeart.nl/en/. Prices include Dutch VAT (btw). We ship within the Netherlands and the EU.

## Shop

- [All art prints](https://printmeart.nl/en/products): the full catalog, filterable by category, artist and museum
- [Artists A–Z](https://printmeart.nl/en/artists): one page per artist with a short biography, key facts, every work we print (year, technique, museum, price) and where the originals hang. Dutch: https://printmeart.nl/nl/kunstenaars
- [Collections](https://printmeart.nl/en/collections): curated collections — museum highlights (Rijksmuseum, The Met, Art Institute of Chicago, …), famous painters, styles and periods, scenes
- [Your design](https://printmeart.nl/en/your-design): fine art print of your own photo or artwork — giclée on Hahnemühle cotton paper or Premium Poster, fixed price per size (table below). Dutch: https://printmeart.nl/nl/your-design
- [Frames](https://printmeart.nl/en/frames): our Natural Oak frame (temporarily unavailable)

Every product page tells the story of the artwork and its artist, and names the museum and credit line it comes from.

## Prices: printing your own photo or artwork

Prices on https://printmeart.nl/en/your-design (November 2026), including Dutch VAT, rolled up in a protective tube. Cotton paper is Hahnemühle Photo Rag (308 g/m²) or Hahnemühle Museum Etching (350 g/m²), same price; Premium Poster is a photographic print on Fujifilm paper (234 g/m²). Professional upscaling for small images: €5. Free shipping in the Netherlands from €75. Every file is checked by hand, and the customer approves the final design before it is printed. Orders can also be picked up at the studio in Den Bosch (by appointment, via support@printmeart.nl). Coming soon: Hahnemühle FineArt Baryta, Hemp and Bamboo, and Canson Rag Photographique II.

| Size (cm) | Premium Poster | Cotton paper |
|---|---|---|
| 13 × 18 | €10.16 | €11.47 |
| 21 × 30 | €13.81 | €17.34 |
| 30 × 40 | €19.08 | €25.79 |
| 40 × 60 | €30.15 | €43.59 |
| 50 × 70 | €40.31 | €59.90 |
| 60 × 90 | €57.84 | €88.07 |

## Papers

One page per paper, with properties, what it suits and (for papers on sale) the price per size. Dutch: https://printmeart.nl/nl/papier

- [Hahnemühle Photo Rag](https://printmeart.nl/en/paper/hahnemuhle-photo-rag): 308 g/m², 100% cotton, smooth matte — available now
- [Hahnemühle Museum Etching](https://printmeart.nl/en/paper/hahnemuhle-museum-etching): 350 g/m², 100% cotton, finely textured matte, no optical brighteners — available now
- [Premium Poster](https://printmeart.nl/en/paper/premium-poster): 234 g/m², photographic print on Fujifilm Crystal Archive paper — available now
- [Hahnemühle FineArt Baryta](https://printmeart.nl/en/paper/hahnemuhle-fineart-baryta): 325 g/m², bright white, high-gloss baryta paper — coming soon
- [Hahnemühle Hemp](https://printmeart.nl/en/paper/hahnemuhle-hemp): 290 g/m², 60% hemp and 40% cotton, matte — coming soon
- [Hahnemühle Bamboo](https://printmeart.nl/en/paper/hahnemuhle-bamboo): 290 g/m², 90% bamboo and 10% cotton, warm natural white, matte — coming soon
- [Canson Rag Photographique II](https://printmeart.nl/en/paper/canson-rag-photographique): 310 g/m², 100% cotton, very smooth matte — coming soon
